makaleler.baslik_en: Transapical Beating-Heart Septal Myectomy for Symptomatic Nonobstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: Initial Clinical Experience.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Transapical Beating-Heart Septal Myectomy for Symptomatic Nonobstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: Initial Clinical Experience.
makaleler.ozet_en: BACKGROUND: Nonobstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (nHCM), defined as hypertrophic cardiomyopathy without left ventricular outflow tract obstruction, remains challenging to treat because of its heterogeneous pathophysiology. This study evaluated the safety and efficacy of transapical beating-heart septal myectomy in patients with symptomatic nHCM. METHODS: Patients with symptomatic, drug-refractory nHCM were prospectively enrolled to undergo transapical beating-heart septal myectomy through a left minithoracotomy.

makaleler.baslik_en: Genome-directed treatment targets and mutational signature biomarkers: a retrospective, pan-solid tumour analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Genome-directed treatment targets and mutational signature biomarkers: a retrospective, pan-solid tumour analysis.
makaleler.ozet_en: BACKGROUND: The clinical application of precision oncology therapies is currently restricted to selected cancer cases harbouring highly specific mutations. Targeted therapies are typically approved for use in specific tumour types in which these alterations occur frequently. We aimed to systematically catalogue targetable alterations and genome-wide biomarkers across all solid tumour types to identify additional therapeutic opportunities.

makaleler.baslik_en: Architecture of a portal complex embedded in the poxvirus core.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Architecture of a portal complex embedded in the poxvirus core.
makaleler.ozet_en: Gene transcription within the viral core is a distinctive feature of poxvirus replication. Following entry into the cytoplasm, the poxvirus core dissociates from the lateral bodies and undergoes expansion, functioning as a compartment for early transcription1. However, how molecules are exchanged between the viral core and the host cytoplasm remains poorly understood. Here, using cryo-electron tomography and sub-tomogram averaging, we determine the structures of the portal complex and its central pore on the vaccinia virus core at 6.7 Å and 4.4 Å resolution, respectively.
